_about: B14's test fixture, written from artifacts/mock/mock.json (npm run export:mock). Every line is fictional demo data from src/mock/: the roster, contentRules, the four communities, a few pieces, the co-op's makers, the policy, three orders and their payouts, Grace N.'s maker payout and statement, the gallery flag, the approvals' decision date, the scripted runs run_01 and run_07, the demo questions and the vibe vocabulary, the demo listing lst_01, the four storefronts (without their blocks) and the model ID.

job.en: Picks which agents run and in what order, then merges their results. No facts of her own
job.zh: 决定由哪些智能体执行、按什么顺序，再汇总它们的结果。她自己不提供任何事实

job.en: Reads the request: intent, budget, recipient, language, the IDs it mentions
job.zh: 读懂请求：意图、预算、送给谁、语言，以及提到的编号

job.en: Turns the request into keywords and filters, runs the search, returns candidates and scores. Find questions go to elastic_agent (Elastic Agent Builder), chosen in code
job.zh: 把请求转成关键词和筛选条件，执行搜索，返回候选作品和分数。找货类问题交给elastic_agent（Elastic Agent Builder），由代码选择

job.en: Puts the final few in order. Each reason is B12's code-built one
job.zh: 为最后几件作品排序。每条理由都是B12由代码生成的理由

job.en: Answers authenticity and meaning only from the community's page, the verification record and the piece's own story and heritage line, quoting its source, and says "I'll ask the maker" otherwise
job.zh: 只依据社区页面、认证记录以及作品自己的故事和传承说明，回答真伪和含义问题，并注明出处；否则就说“我去问问匠人”

job.en: Order status, shipping, returns. Read-only. Arrival dates come from arrival_window, which the run calls as code, so no model does date arithmetic. On the buyer side it looks up only the orders on screen (L17)
job.zh: 订单状态、配送和退货，只读不改。送达日期来自arrival_window，由流程以代码调用，不让模型计算日期。在买家端只查询屏幕上的订单（L17）

job.en: Writes the reply in the person's language from the facts the others returned, and relays a maker's answer in her own words
job.zh: 根据其他智能体返回的事实，用提问者的语言撰写回复，并原话转达匠人的回答

job.en: Drafts a listing in English and Chinese from the maker's notes, and marks the version the maker didn't write (L27)
job.zh: 根据匠人的笔记起草中英文商品信息，并标出不是匠人亲自写的版本（L27）

job.en: Describes what's visible in a picture, in plain shape and color words
job.zh: 用平实的形状和颜色词描述图片里看得见的内容

job.en: Proposes vibe keywords for the maker to approve
job.zh: 提议氛围关键词，交给匠人批准

job.en: Checks a draft against the community's protocols and the maker's facts. content_check() backs it in code (L26)
job.zh: 对照社区的规定和匠人提供的事实核查草稿，并由代码中的content_check()把关（L26）

job.en: Builds the index entry and its vector, writes it to cindia-drafts
job.zh: 生成索引条目及其向量，写入cindia-drafts

job.en: Matches payouts to orders
job.zh: 把结款与订单对应起来

job.en: Explains the catch
job.zh: 解释查出的问题

job.en: Derives the books and the workbook
job.zh: 推算账本并生成Excel报表

job.en: Scores the planted errors
job.zh: 为测试用例评分

job.en: Crawls the sandbox market through Apify
job.zh: 通过Apify抓取沙盒市场

job.en: Scores look-alikes
job.zh: 为相似商品打分

job.en: Checks what a found listing claims
job.zh: 核查找到的商品声称了什么

job.en: Picks the claim words for the report template, for the owner
job.zh: 为报告模板挑选声明用词，交给负责人

job.en: Drafts a storefront
job.zh: 起草店铺页面

name.zh: 纳瓦霍（Diné）编织与银饰合作社

place.zh: 美国亚利桑那州纳瓦霍保留区

craft.en: Wool weavings, silver and turquoise jewelry
craft.zh: 羊毛编织与绿松石银饰

about.en: Diné (Navajo) weavers at the co-op weave wool on upright looms, and its smiths decorate silver with hand stamps and set turquoise in it. The co-op makes wall weavings, rugs, earrings, rings, pendant necklaces and cuff bracelets.
about.zh: 合作社的纳瓦霍（Diné）织工在立式织机上织羊毛，银匠用手工印模为银器压花，并在银饰上镶嵌绿松石。合作社制作壁挂编织、地毯、耳环、戒指、吊坠项链和手镯。

protocols.en: No ceremonial pieces or designs, such as Yei or sandpainting designs.
protocols.zh: 不收录仪式用品或仪式图案，例如Yei图案或沙画图案。

protocols.en: No meanings for patterns. A pattern is described by its shapes and colors.
protocols.zh: 不解释图案的含义。图案只用形状和颜色来描述。

by.en: The Navajo Nation, under the U.S. Indian Arts and Crafts Act, in a real launch
by.zh: 正式上线时由纳瓦霍（Diné）族依据美国《印第安艺术和手工艺品法》认证

note.en: In a real launch, makers would be enrolled members of the Navajo Nation or certified by it as Indian artisans, as the U.S. Indian Arts and Crafts Act defines. Cindia would keep only a yes or no, never the record. No real check was done for this demo.
note.zh: 正式上线时，匠人须是纳瓦霍（Diné）族的在册成员，或经其认证为印第安手工艺人，以美国《印第安艺术和手工艺品法》的定义为准。Cindia只保存“是”或“否”，从不保存记录本身。本演示没有做任何真实核查。

name.zh: 一个奥吉布瓦（Ojibwe）串珠合作社

craft.en: Floral beadwork: earrings, pouches and necklaces
craft.zh: 花卉串珠：耳环、小包和项链

about.en: Ojibwe beadworkers at the co-op stitch glass seed beads onto cloth or leather, often in floral designs, and also weave beads on a loom. The co-op makes beaded earrings, pouches and necklaces.
about.zh: 合作社的奥吉布瓦（Ojibwe）串珠匠人把玻璃小珠缝在布或皮革上，常做成花卉图案，也在织机上编串珠。合作社制作串珠耳环、小包和项链。

protocols.en: No regalia, such as bandolier bags or dance aprons.
protocols.zh: 不收录典礼服饰，例如斜挎珠饰袋或舞蹈围裙。
不收录烟斗袋或烟草袋。

protocols.en: No meanings for flowers or plants.
protocols.zh: 不解释花卉或植物的含义。

by.en: An Ojibwe tribe or band, under the U.S. Indian Arts and Crafts Act, in a real launch
by.zh: 正式上线时由某个奥吉布瓦（Ojibwe）部落或族群依据美国《印第安艺术和手工艺品法》认证

note.en: In a real launch, makers would be enrolled members of an Ojibwe tribe or band or certified by it as Indian artisans, as the U.S. Indian Arts and Crafts Act defines. Cindia would keep only a yes or no, never the record. No real check was done for this demo.
note.zh: 正式上线时，匠人须是某个奥吉布瓦（Ojibwe）部落或族群的在册成员，或经其认证为印第安手工艺人，以美国《印第安艺术和手工艺品法》的定义为准。Cindia只保存“是”或“否”，从不保存记录本身。本演示没有做任何真实核查。

about.en: Acoma potters at the studio coil their pots by hand with thin walls, cover them with a white slip, polish them with a smooth stone and paint them with a yucca brush. The studio makes jars, bowls and seed pots in black, orange and white.
about.zh: 陶艺坊的阿科马（Acoma）陶匠手工盘筑薄壁陶器，施白色泥浆，用光滑的石头打磨，再用yucca（丝兰）笔绘制。陶艺坊制作黑、橙、白三色的陶罐、陶碗和种子罐。

protocols.zh: 不收录仪式用陶器或仪式图案。

protocols.en: No named designs and no meanings for designs.
protocols.zh: 不使用有名称的图案，也不解释图案的含义。

by.en: The Pueblo of Acoma, under the U.S. Indian Arts and Crafts Act, in a real launch
by.zh: 正式上线时由阿科马（Acoma）普韦布洛依据美国《印第安艺术和手工艺品法》认证

note.en: In a real launch, makers would be enrolled members of the Pueblo of Acoma or certified by it as Indian artisans, as the U.S. Indian Arts and Crafts Act defines. Cindia would keep only a yes or no, never the record. No real check was done for this demo.
note.zh: 正式上线时，匠人须是阿科马（Acoma）普韦布洛的在册成员，或经其认证为印第安手工艺人，以美国《印第安艺术和手工艺品法》的定义为准。Cindia只保存“是”或“否”，从不保存记录本身。本演示没有做任何真实核查。

name.zh: 一个塞米诺尔（Seminole）拼布合作社

about.en: Seminole sewers at the co-op sew strips of cloth into long bands on sewing machines, then cut the bands and piece them back together in rows. The co-op makes patchwork skirts and jackets, including children's sizes.
about.zh: 合作社的塞米诺尔（Seminole）缝纫匠人用缝纫机把布条缝成长条，再裁开、重新拼成一排排花样。合作社制作拼布裙和拼布夹克，也有儿童尺码。

protocols.en: No named patchwork designs and no meanings for them.
protocols.zh: 不使用有名称的拼布图案，也不解释其含义。
任何作品都不作为戏服出售。

story.en: A black cotton jacket with three bands of red, yellow and white patchwork across the back and sleeves. Rickrack runs between the bands, and it fits a women's medium.

body.en: Every community ships from its own region with tracked shipping. Each piece ships within the lead time shown on its page, then arrives 6 to 10 days after it ships.
body.zh: 每个社区都从各自所在的地区发货，并提供物流追踪。每件作品会在其页面标注的备货期内发出，发货后6到10天送达。

body.en: A piece can be returned within 30 days of delivery, unused and as it arrived. Cindia refunds the full price once the piece is back with its maker.
body.zh: 作品送达后30天内可以退货，须未使用并保持收到时的样子。作品退回匠人手中后，Cindia全额退款。

body.en: Wool: hang it or lay it flat out of direct sun, and spot-clean it with cold water. Silver: wipe it with a soft dry cloth and keep it dry. Beadwork: keep it dry and store it flat. Pottery: dust it with a soft dry brush and keep it away from water. Cotton patchwork: wash it cold on a gentle cycle and hang it to dry.
body.zh: 羊毛：悬挂或平放，避免阳光直射，用冷水局部清洁。银饰：用柔软的干布擦拭，保持干燥。串珠：保持干燥，平放收纳。陶器：用柔软的干刷子除尘，避免接触水。棉质拼布：用冷水轻柔洗涤，挂起晾干。

body.en: In a real launch, each maker would be an enrolled member of their nation or certified by it as an Indian artisan, as the U.S. Indian Arts and Crafts Act defines, and Cindia would keep only a yes or no, never the record. No real check was done for this demo. If a piece isn't as described, Cindia refunds it in full.
body.zh: 正式上线时，每位匠人须是其所属部族的在册成员，或经其认证为印第安手工艺人，以美国《印第安艺术和手工艺品法》的定义为准；Cindia只保存“是”或“否”，从不保存记录本身。本演示没有做任何真实核查。如果作品与描述不符，Cindia全额退款。

body.en: A commission is paid in milestones. Cindia holds the buyer's money and pays the maker each milestone's share only after the owner approves it. Money for milestones not yet released stays with Cindia, and if a commission is canceled, that money goes back to the buyer.
body.zh: 定制作品按里程碑付款。Cindia代为保管买家的款项，每个里程碑经负责人批准后，才把该里程碑的份额付给匠人。尚未发放的款项留在Cindia；如果定制取消，这部分款项退还给买家。

explanation.en: The gallery's September statement charged 50% commission on all four sales and paid $1,700.00. The signed contract says 40%, which leaves the co-op $2,040.00 on $3,400.00 of sales. The bank shows $1,700.00 on Sep 30, matching the statement, not the contract. I trust the contract, so the gallery owes $340.00.
explanation.zh: 画廊9月对账单对四笔销售都按50%收取佣金，实付$1,700.00。已签合同约定40%，按$3,400.00的销售额，合作社应得$2,040.00。银行流水显示9月30日到账$1,700.00，与对账单一致，与合同不符。我以合同为准，画廊还欠$340.00。
